nib.definition: n. the writing point of a pen
nib.translation:
n. 嘴, 笔尖
vt. 装尖头, 削尖, 修换(笔)尖

nibbed.definition: a. Having a nib or point.

nibbing.definition: p. pr. & vb. n. of Nib

vt. 装尖头；削尖；插入

nibble.definition:

v. 一点一点地咬, 细咬, 吹毛求疵

nibbled.translation: v. 啃, 一点一点地咬（吃）( nibble的过去式和过去分词 ); 啃出（洞）, 一点一点咬出（洞）; 慢慢减少; 小口咬
